# `gstat` for [prompt](/commands/categories/prompt.md)

<div class='command-title'>Get the git status of a repo</div>

::: warning This command requires a plugin
The `gstat` command resides in the `gstat` plugin.
To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_gstat`.
See the [Plugins](/book/plugins.html) chapter in the book for more information.
:::


## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> gstat {flags} (path)```

## Flags

 -  `--no-tag`: Disable git tag resolving.

## Parameters

 -  `path`: Path to repo.

## Notes
Every count is -1 outside a git repository. Inside one, the status counts (idx_*, wt_*, ignored and conflicts) are -1 when the status can't be read, for example with a split or sparse index or in a bare repository. wt_renamed counts unstaged renames, a deleted file paired with a similar untracked file, which then don't count as wt_deleted or wt_untracked; a renamed file that was also edited counts in wt_modified too. An ignored directory counts once in ignored.
